data.title: 中野四叶 · 夏日祭典的红苹果糖
data.description: 夏日祭典热闹的人潮与红色纸灯笼暖光下，四叶开心地双手捧着晶亮红艳的苹果糖递来，迫不及待地想要与心上人分享这份纯粹的甜蜜。
data.action: holding candy apple, pulling sleeve, turning excitedly
data.promptProse: Dashing happily through a bustling Japanese summer festival illuminated by red paper lanterns, Nakano Yotsuba holds up a bright candy apple. She turns around with sparkling eyes and reaches out to pull the viewer along into the festivities.
data.animaCaption: Offering her shiny red candy apple under the glowing festival lanterns, her eyes sparkle with excitement.
